description: Fictional property operations data for agentic AI and RAG development. No affiliation with RealPage or FedEx. Policies are invented demo rules, not legal requirements or real operating procedures.
usage_notes: Index only policy_documents for RAG. Use structured collections through authorized tools for current operational facts.
Keep evaluation_cases outside all retrieval indexes and model-visible context; they contain expected answers.
demo_auth_contexts are test fixtures, not credentials. Production authorization must come from a verified identity provider.
Resolve unit and property access on the server; never trust a property_id or resident_id supplied by the model.
Property membership alone does not permit a resident to read another resident's work orders.
Use the snapshot time as the evaluation clock. Reset the seed state between independent evaluation cases.
All example.com email addresses, people, properties, records, and policy thresholds are fictional.
Do not expose internal notes to residents or ingest work orders and resident profiles into a shared vector index.
